title: Austin Power Plant Gas Deal Moves Forward
summary:
*   Austin city officials held a special meeting to discuss a new contract for supplying gas to the city's power plants.
*   An Advisory Committee met with city leaders, giving their strong approval and urging them to proceed with the gas agreement.
*   The city authorized the City Manager to finalize the detailed contract for the crucial power plant gas supply.

The meeting was called to order with Mayor Miller presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Long, Palmer, White, Mayor Miller Absent:
Councilman Pearson
Present also: W. T. Williams, Jr., City Manager; Doren R. Eskew, City Attorney The Mayor
announced that this meeting was called for the purpose of discussing with the Advisory
Committee a proposed gas contract.
Present from the Advisory Committee were MR. KARL WAGNER, MR. W. P. WATTS, MR. MARVIN
TURNER, MR. G. L. HUCKABY, MR. DAVID BARROW, MR.SPILLAR, MR. TED WIMBERLY.
Mayor Miller reviewed the matter of a proposed gas contract for furnishing gas to the
Power Plants. Members of the Committee expressed approval of the contract and urged the
Council to proceed. The Council authorized the City Manager to proceed to write up the
difinitive contract.
There being no further business, the Council adjourned at 12:00 Noon, subject to the call
of the Mayor.
